title: ComfyUI: free Midjourney alternative
caption:
Midjourney charges $10/month. ComfyUI makes AI images on your own PC for free 🎨

✅ Makes images, videos, 3D and audio from a text prompt
✅ Ready-made workflow templates to start from
✅ Runs on your own computer, even offline
✅ Desktop app for Windows and Mac
✅ No subscription, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac (Linux via manual install)
ℹ️ It runs on your own hardware, so a dedicated graphics card (GPU) is strongly recommended. The optional cloud/partner models and Comfy Cloud are paid.

Comment "COMFY" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
